{{Quote|Ex-squeeze me, but da most safest place t'would be Gunga city. 'Tis where I grew up... 'Tis a hidden city.|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]|<ref name="SWE1" />}}
'''Otoh Gunga''', also known as '''Gunga City''', was the largest [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and the seat of their [[Gungan society|government]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|The Naboo never come to Otoh Gunga. We never go to their city of Theed. Our only real neighbors are the scalefish that surround the bubbles of our city.|[[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]]|<ref name="Trouble">''[[Gungan Trouble!]]''</ref>}}
[[File:ITW1_Otoh_Gunga.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Otoh Gunga cutaway.]]
The [[City/Legends|city]] of Otoh Gunga was anchored to a massive underwater cliff deep within [[Lake Paonga/Legends|Lake Paonga]], and was a mass of [[Hydrostatic bubble/Legends|hydrostatic bubbles]] which keep [[Water/Legends|water]] out while allowing the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] to enter through them. There were satellite clusters outside of the city, including buildings which had been cast out from other Gungan settlements.<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> While the Gungans could survive both on land and underwater, they chose to build their [[Capital/Legends|capital]] city under Lake Paonga to avoid contact with the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Nabooian Humans]].<ref name="Trouble" />

==History==
{{Quote|Boss Gallo was good to hisen word. Hesa built the beautiful city of Otoh Gunga, and long it remained a symbol of peace between all Gungans.|[[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]]|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:Otoh_Gunga.jpg|thumb|300px|Otoh Gunga during the Blockade of Naboo.]]
Otoh Gunga was founded by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Gallo/Legends|Gallo]] in [[3000 BBY]]<ref name="EA" /> on the site of Boss [[Rogoe/Legends|Rogoe's]] [[Rogoe's keep|fortress city]], [[Spearhead/Legends|Spearhead]]. Otoh Gunga was originally occupied by the population of [[Otoh Jahai]], [[Otoh Langua/Legends|Otoh Langua]], [[Otoh Mandassa]], [[Otoh Raban]], [[Otoh Sancture]], and [[Otoh Urs]], after Gallo united all the Gungan tribes under one banner.<ref name="SW:GB" />

As of the Battle of Naboo, Otoh Gunga was home to a million Gungans living in a massive bubble city that had grown out from the original foundation laid by Gallo's people, an area now known as the [[Ancient Quarter/Legends|Ancient Quarter]].<ref name="TPMVD" /> The main focus of the city was a dense cluster of bubbles in the central district, radiating out from between walkways and plazas.

Notable additions to the city included the [[Otoh Villages/Legends|Otoh Villages]], where most Gungans lived and worked, and the [[City Bigspace/Legends|City Bigspace]], a popular concourse constructed on the orders of Boss [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]], wishing to leave his mark on the city. The city also included [[Tribubble bongo/Legends|bongo]] pens, [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] and one of its most famous attractions, the [[Otoh Gunga Zoological Research Facility]].

After standing for three thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] as a symbol of Gungan unity and strength, Otoh Gunga [[Siege of Otoh Gunga|fell]] to the might of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the latter stages of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="SW:GB" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="EA" /> In the early stages of the invasion, the Trade Federation had only heard rumors of a primitive underwater civilization.<ref name="SW:GB" />

[[File:Otoh_evacuation.png|thumb|left|250px|The Rep Council discussing Otoh Gunga's evacuation.]]
Having confirmed the existence of the Gungans, [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ordered a full assault on their strongest fortress. Led by [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]] and assisted by [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]], a contingent of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] and aquatic [[S-DST|destroyers]] attacked and besieged Otoh Gunga. Demoralized and defeated, Boss Nass informed the [[Gungan High Council/Legends|Rep Council]] of the situation, trying to convince the [[Rep/Legends|Reps]] they needed to evacuate soon before the city was destroyed. Many members of the council wanted to stay, but Rep [[Been]] finally convinced them to go. He knew the secrets of old Gungan hidden places, and suggested they fled to the Gungan's [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Sacred Place]] to plan his counterattack.<ref name="Trouble" /><ref name="SW:GB" /> After Boss Nass [[Battle of the Sacred Place|joined with]] the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] to expel the Trade Federation of Naboo, Otoh Gunga was re-occupied.<ref name="SW:GB" />

Many years later during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Lyonie/Legends|Lyonie]] had become the Boss of Otoh Gunga. He fell under the sway of [[Minister]] [[Rish Loo/Legends|Rish Loo]], who had allied with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and forced Lyonie to call the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] together to march against the Royal Naboo. [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] traveled to Otoh Gunga and revealed Loo's treachery in time for the Grand Army to [[Skirmish on Naboo/Legends|expel]] a Confederacy invasion force.<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref>

Several years later, during the early stages of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Otoh Gunga was advertized as a visitable locale for the Star Tours travel agency. In addition, a Star Tours vessel briefly passed by this area when attempting to access a [[Naboo Rebel hangar|Rebel-owned hangar]] on Naboo during a [[Skirmish over Naboo (Galactic Civil War)|skirmish]] in the orbit of Naboo.<ref name="ST II">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The name Otoh Gunga was never mentioned in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''The Phantom Menace'']]. [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] called it Gunga City, and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] referred to it as "The Gungan city". In all novelizations of the film however, it is referred to as Otoh Gunga.

Otoh Gunga appears in a cutscene in the [[2005]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''. The scene was later included in the game's [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]].
